model_output.rationale: All four lines denied OA-18 (exact duplicate) with MOA N111. Claim filed as frequency 1 (original) to Medicare Part B (MB). 835 carries payer claim control 2623576767957, confirming adjudication. The entire claim duplicates a previously adjudicated claim on file for the same provider/member/DOS/procedures. No false-duplicate indicator — services are same-session timed therapy, not bilateral or repeat encounters. OA group: never patient liability. Duplicate edit is hard-coded and unappealable.

root_cause.explanation: Entire claim denied OA-18 on all lines with N111. Payer matched provider/member/DOS/procedure against a previously adjudicated claim. Claim sent as frequency 1 (original), triggering the hard-coded duplicate edit.

next_action.detail: Do not resubmit. Check the original claim's status via Novitas portal or IVR. If it paid, post that payment and close. If the original was denied, address that denial on its own terms. Never resend — repeat submissions risk program-integrity action.
